# Addon loot file sample (WEB-96)

`Loot.lua` is what `npm run export:addon-loot` writes (`src/core/recipes/addonLoot.ts`), made from invented bosses and
drops in `tests/unit/addonLoot.test.ts` (the test checks it byte for byte). A sample of the format for the addon
(CommunitiesForever `Data\Loot.lua`, CF-106): no real loot data. The real file is generated from the item database
at release and committed to the addon only.
